summary: This Form 8-K by Arrow Financial Corporation reports quarterly earnings, declares a routine cash dividend of $0.30 per share, and provides an investor presentation. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. The filing is a standard current report of operating results and financial condition under Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01, with no advisory appointments, structural changes, or event-driven special circumstances.
